$comment: Gnome glider network. 'index' is the destination's number in the cache's glider scripts (pilot_journey varp 153 = from << 14 | to; pilot_previous_destination varbit 9584), 'button' its component on the glider map (interface 138), 'x/y/z' the arrival tile and 'pilots' who flies from there (by name, standing within 16 tiles of it). 'multinpcVar': its pilot shows by pilot_multinpc_var (varbit 9567: visible 9576, dest 9575), set on landing there. Indices, buttons and arrival tiles are from an rsprox capture of a flight to every destination; requirements from the Wiki. Lemanto Andra is arrival-only: its glider crashes, and its pilot has no Glider option.
